Message:
How long have I been running?
My stomach wouldn’t
stop growling...and soon,
I couldn’t move another inch.

Everything went dark...
and I fell straight to the ground.

Mommy, Daddy, I’m sorry...
You went through so much
to save me, but...

I heard a voice.
Then, just like
Mommy used to do,
someone knelt down
and held me—

When I opened my eyes,
I was lying in a soft,
fluffy bed.
Beside me sat a pretty lady—

Gracie. She explained that
she found me collapsed
in front of her mansion.

When I told her what
happened in the village,
Gracie’s face
scrunched up a little.

“I see...
Your hometown was
targeted by the Witch Hunt.”

Then she looked at me,
and after thinking for a bit,
asked me a question.

“If you’d like,
why don’t you
work here for me?”
